additional_report.disposition: Full report read; accepted as dated owner context, no independent primary rerun or new gate grade. Strong-credit cumulative broadening differs from a system funding break; existing final LIQ-07 window still pending.

dispositions.TERRY: Final owner closeout packet read; prior repair/booking acceptance stays closed. Will-origin ask/answer reported; no process termination inferred. No redundant reply or review.
dispositions.BOND_BROCK: Owner publication refusals, BOND scoped operator approval and later shared-origin receipt read. BOND approval does not expand to other payloads. No rejected operation bypassed. Main research is owner-reported context; source and current funded-exposure gaps retained. Current PROME push requires its own actual preflight and approval review.
dispositions.WALTER: Completed source/mark/routing and later closeout packets read; earlier pending-publication clauses are dated, not current absence claims. Live LAST_COMPLETION remains canonical; no duplicate bookmarking or diesel commission. Power bridge is separate from completed diesel work.
dispositions.WAL: Dated FFIEC/research/housekeeping/closeout and later REGINALD-consumption packets read. Later continuation supersedes any inference that earlier closeout means owner remains inactive. Public earnings path plausible does not establish profit conversion or an expectations gap. Existing source/recorder/credential dependencies persist. No independent rerun of owner numerical/repair tests.
dispositions.LIQUID: Report consumed at exact hash above. Preserve next published funding observations, final branch timing and withheld swap-line instrument. No duplicate study or score/trade change.

remaining: Full primary/repair acceptance not implied by packet triage; source owners retain their named missing evidence. Later arrivals require next-boot reconciliation; native cross-window transport unavailable. No gate/catalyst changes or new requests to Will.

maintenance_report.disposition: Full owner report read as maintenance receipt; no independent source/code acceptance claimed. Existing criteria and dates remain owner-governed. BROCK audit packet read as reported findings; no broad repair commission or missing primary claim certified.
